This ambiguity suggests that the competitive landscape is highly fragmented, with safety consulting often bundled into broader operational, environmental, or engineering service packages rather than being offered as a standalone discipline by pure-play safety firms. As the industry continues to mature, further targeted research will be essential to map the precise contours of this competitive landscape and to fully identify the niche players driving the future of mining safety in South Africa.
